headline: Iran War Drives Oil Prices Past $100 a Barrel
summary: Oil price spike gets folded into a broader Democratic and anti-war critique of Trump's Iran war costs, while many voices remain focused on unrelated topics.

voices.quote: Who knows where we'll be when the war enters its sixth month and how much Americans will be paying at the pump?

-Household electricity costs are up 18%

-Gas prices are up 40%
-ACA out-of-pocket premiums are up 58%
-Inflation is at a three-year high

"New Golden Age"
What happens when you remove more than a billion barrels of oil from the global energy supply? Both the government and futures markets assure us everything will be fine. That’s probably not true.
